notes: Identity verified from the supplied canonical text: title The Origins of the Shape Bias: Evidence From the Tsimane’; Julian Jara-Ettinger, Roger Levy, Jeanette Sakel, Tomas Huanca, and Edward Gibson; Journal of Experimental Psychology: General, 2022, 151(10), 2437–2447; DOI 10.1037/xge0001195. This is primary published-article PDF-derived text, with methods, results, figures, discussion, and references, not an abstract or secondary article. The canonical file contains truncation-warning text at its beginning, so no claim of pristine whole-document capture is made; the target Results paragraph and Figure 2 note are present. No PDF path supplied, so no rendering performed. Only es_value_o and pval_value_o are assigned. N, replication, and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. Printed 68.75% retained as percentage, with no conversion to a 0–1 proportion. No Experiment-5-specific inferential p is printed in the inspected Results paragraph or Figure 2, which supplies bootstrap confidence intervals. The nearby Main Analysis pools Experiments 1, 2, 5, 6, and 7, and reports population/age/intercept coefficients and p values; these do not test the Experiment 5 descriptive percentage alone and were not paired with it. No N arithmetic performed.
